name: io.github.bike4mind/bike4mind
title: Bike4Mind
description: Notebooks, agents, files and RAG from your Bike4Mind workspace, as MCP tools.

environmentVariables.name: B4M_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bike4Mind API key. Alternatively sign in once with `b4m` and the stored OAuth token is used.

environmentVariables.name: B4M_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API endpoint. Optional for the official build, which bakes in a default at release time; required if that default is empty (a fork) or to point at a self-hosted deployment. Without any endpoint, `mcp serve` exits at startup.
